request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:CATAPULT

layers.text: Recolour the brown strap under the belly and every other brown or tan part of the body to dark charcoal grey, so that nothing is brown. Change nothing else: keep the plain bright red frill, the blue skin, the cream beak, horns and claws, the pose, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
